metadata.source_package_note: Packet 010 is the controlling source. The standalone F10.md was not used because it is a Disco proxy under the dispatch map. F16.md was used only as a non-controlling shoegaze/dream-pop aid for archetype 073 and is noted as misnumbered relative to the dispatch map.

normalization.album_song_seed_policy: Packet 010 did not name album or song objects; instantiated album/song candidates are marked existing_seed=false even when the artist was a Packet 010 seed.
normalization.version_policy: Distinct recordings, covers, live/acoustic versions, and album/song title collisions are not merged; ambiguity is flagged in warnings.
